The training set has 89,042 sentence pairs, and the test set has 100 pairs. WikiLarge is also from Wikipedia corpus whose training set contains 296,402 sentence pairs BIBREF19 , BIBREF20 . WikiLarge includes 8 (reference) simplifications for 2,359 sentences split into 2,000 for development and 359 for testing.
